_comment: Material 3 dark. Fully opaque surfaces, no glass at all — proof that the default look is a theme, not the architecture. Elevation is carried by surface tone the way Material does it, rather than by translucency.
_surfaces: M3 surface + surface-container tones. Alpha 1.0 throughout, so Solidity has nothing left to do and an unblurred compositor looks identical to a blurred one.
_edges: Material draws outlines, not lit glass edges — outline-variant, flat, no white sheen.
_shape: M3 uses larger corners than the glass default: 16dp on cards, full pill on controls.
_blur: Saturation 1.0 and low contrast: nothing shows through an opaque surface, so leaving the effect on would only cost GPU time.
_elevation: M3 level-2 shadow: tighter and darker than the glass default's wide soft falloff.
